_comment: The character pipeline's desired state in Supagen. The setup skill reads this file after scripts/templates.json and creates, through MCP, what is missing in the user's workspace; it never creates a slug or a version that already exists. It is separate from scripts/templates.json so that the recreation templates and their behaviour do not change. Model limits and prices are in models.json beside this file.

templates.name: ugc-character
templates.description: Character pipeline segments (scripts/character/generate.sh). MiniMax H3 Max reference-to-video, 9:16, 768P, audio on. Messages-only: the segment prompt and its references arrive in the invocation messages. Duration in video_settings.extensions; top-level duration null. Generated at 768P and upscaled once to 1080x1920 at assembly.
templates._version_rules: Every version here MUST keep system_instructions unset, variables empty, duration null, and the integer duration inside extensions, as in scripts/templates.json. One version per duration: the REST invoke endpoint runs the ACTIVE version, so a run at another length is a new version, activated together with scripts/character/state.py model set.

versions.name: v1-5s-9x16
versions._model_note: DEFAULT. $0.08/s, 5 to 15 s, at most 4 reference images. 5 s is the model's minimum and the length of every planned test run.

templates.name: ugc-character-face-replace
templates.create_when: never: the edit route it serves is retired (models.json motion_copy.routes.edit, 2026-10-04)
templates.description: RETIRED. Motion copy, the edit route (models.json motion_copy.routes.edit): Wan 2.7 Edit Video. The masked reference clip is the source video and the character's face the one reference image. Messages-only. The output is the source video's length: no duration setting. 720p, 9:16.
templates._version_rules: Every version keeps system_instructions unset, variables empty and duration null, as in ugc-character.

versions.name: v1-720p-9x16
versions._model_note: $0.10/s at 720p, source video 2 to 10 s, one reference image. The resolution form ("720p") is the catalog's; check it on the version before the paid test.

templates.name: ugc-character-face-guided
templates.create_when: the founder approves the paid motion-copy test (models.json motion_copy); setup does not create it before
templates.description: Motion copy, the guided route (models.json motion_copy.routes.guided): MiniMax H3 reference-to-video. The masked reference clip is a video reference and the character's face an image reference; a new clip guided by them, trimmed to the clip's length at assembly. Messages-only. 9:16, 768P, 5 s.
templates._version_rules: Every version keeps system_instructions unset, variables empty and duration null, as in ugc-character. Duration inside extensions, one version per length.

versions.name: v1-5s-9x16
versions._model_note: $0.06/s at 768p, 5 to 15 s, video reference 2 to 15 s.

templates.name: ugc-character-face-animate-replace
templates.create_when: only when a shot names its fallback route; created 2026-10-06/07 for the founder's tests
templates.description: FALLBACK (founder, 2026-10-07; the default is ugc-character-face-kling-motion). Motion copy, the replace route (models.json motion_copy.routes.replace): Wan 2.2 Animate replace. The original reference clip is the source video and the character's face the one image. No prompt. Messages-only. The output is the source video's length: no duration setting. 720p.
templates._version_rules: Every version keeps system_instructions unset, variables empty and duration null.

versions.name: v1-720p
versions._model_note: $0.005 a source-video frame at 720p (the higher of the catalog's two figures). No text input.

templates.name: ugc-character-face-animate-move
templates.create_when: only when a shot names its fallback route; created 2026-10-06/07 for the founder's tests
templates.description: FALLBACK (founder, 2026-10-07; the default is ugc-character-face-kling-motion). Motion copy on Supagen: wan-2-2-animate-move. The original reference clip is the video part and the character's approved first frame the one picture. Messages-only.
templates._version_rules: system_instructions unset, variables empty, duration null.

versions.name: v1
versions._model_note: $0.005 a source frame at 720p. No text input.

templates.name: ugc-character-face-kling-motion
templates.create_when: the first motion-copy reaction (the default route); created 2026-10-07
templates.description: DEFAULT motion-copy template (founder, 2026-10-07): the motion route, Kling 3.0 Pro Motion Control. The original reference clip (padded to 3.0 s) is the video part, the character's approved first frame the one picture, and a short prompt the text part. character_orientation video, keep_original_sound false. Messages-only.
templates._version_rules: system_instructions unset, variables empty, duration null.
